physical: Running couplings — The strengths of the interactions depend on the energy scale at which they are probed: the electromagnetic coupling grows with energy, the strong coupling falls.
reflected_sentence: In Vibrational Reality, the strength of each pull shifts with the conscious energy at which it is met: one grows with conscious energy, the other fades.
rule_reason: No cost, no resistance, and no separation appears; the running of a coupling with energy is a dependence, not a cost, so it keeps its shape.
interpretation: The dependence keeps its shape. Energy reflects to conscious energy; the couplings have no frozen partner, so only the pattern of growing and falling carries across.
closing: The rule decided on its own: no costs, keeps shape. The unmapped couplings limit the reflection to a pattern, not a verdict on the rule.
